claim_text: Type2-inner-deductive and Type2-outer-inductive loops, composed from the same four (terrain, operator) stage contents in different orders, produce dynamically distinguishable trajectories: ordered signature distance >> resampling self-null, while unordered (best-match) distance falls within the null band.
claim_scope_note: The executable frozen measurement compares the primary per-segment SINDy terrain-flow signature. The two Type2 loops use the same four terrain stages in different orders. The actual discrete operator placements are listed below and are applied during trajectory generation; they are not rewritten to be identical labels.

generator.state: 2x2 density matrix rho = 0.5*(I + x*sx + y*sy + z*sz), with probe Bloch vectors of radius 0.62

axis6_ordering.up: operator first, then terrain GKSL flow
axis6_ordering.down: terrain GKSL flow first, then operator

measurement_procedure.probe_draws: Use the required command-line seed to initialize numpy default_rng. Draw independent train, null, and test probe sets in that order. Each set contains 9 random unit directions scaled to Bloch radius 0.62.
measurement_procedure.trajectory_generation: For each probe, run 3 complete cycles of the loop. At each stage, apply the axis6 ordering. Store the continuous terrain-flow trajectory for that segment; discrete operators are applied before or after flow according to axis6_sign and affect subsequent arrivals.
measurement_procedure.integrator: RK4 with stage time 1.0 and 220 equal steps; density matrices are Hermitian-normalized after each RK4 step and operator application.
measurement_procedure.sindy: For each of the 4 segment positions in each loop, fit one PySINDy model to train flow trajectories using PolynomialLibrary(degree=2) and STLSQ(threshold=0.02). Score the model on held-out test trajectories using derivative R2. Also fit a null-refit model from the independent null probe trajectories.
measurement_procedure.signature: The primary loop signature is the ordered tuple of the four SINDy flow coefficient matrices.
measurement_procedure.ordered_distance: Sum over positions 1..4 of RMS coefficient distance between corresponding segment models.
measurement_procedure.unordered_distance: Minimum over all 24 permutations of the second loop positions of the same summed RMS coefficient distance.
measurement_procedure.null_band: Maximum unordered self-null distance between each loop signature and its independently refit null signature.
measurement_procedure.recording_rule: A replicator must record stdout and results JSON for their chosen seed before comparing to expected_ours.json.

pre_registered_criteria.instrument_validity_gate: Every real segment fit must have held-out derivative R2 >= 0.9.
pre_registered_criteria.fail: Any gate false. The script must report FAIL honestly; do not tune seed or thresholds after seeing expected_ours.json.
